phases.name: Year 1
phases.subtitle: Explore
phases.description: Engineering & Biology Foundations — Build STEM literacy, explore bioengineering careers, and develop laboratory skills.

milestones.label: Explore bioengineering career pathways
milestones.description: Introduction to engineering disciplines with emphasis on bioengineering applications in biomedical devices, pharmaceutical manufacturing, tissue engineering, and bioinformatics. Students complete an engineering design challenge.

milestones.label: Build calculus foundations for engineering
milestones.description: Functions, limits, derivatives, and introduction to integration. The mathematical foundation for all engineering analysis, modeling, and design courses.

milestones.label: Master general chemistry for engineers
milestones.description: Atomic structure, chemical bonding, stoichiometry, and thermochemistry. Provides the chemistry foundation for biomaterials, biochemistry, and chemical process courses.

milestones.label: Join BMES or bioengineering student organization
milestones.description: Join the Biomedical Engineering Society (BMES) student chapter, NSBE, or SWE. Attend research seminars, lab tours, and networking events with bioengineering professionals and faculty researchers.

milestones.label: Study biology foundations for bioengineering
milestones.description: Cell biology, genetics, and molecular biology fundamentals. Students connect biological principles to bioengineering applications in drug delivery, tissue engineering, and biosensors.

phases.name: Year 2
phases.subtitle: Engage
phases.description: Core Bioengineering Sciences — Deepen engineering science knowledge and begin laboratory research exposure.

milestones.label: Master biomechanics and statics
milestones.description: Study of forces and motion in biological systems including musculoskeletal mechanics, tissue stress analysis, and biomedical device mechanics. Students apply engineering statics to human anatomy.

milestones.label: Study biochemistry and molecular engineering
milestones.description: Protein structure, enzyme kinetics, metabolic pathways, and molecular engineering principles. Students analyze biological molecules and design experiments for bioprocess applications.

milestones.label: Begin undergraduate research with faculty mentor
milestones.description: Join a faculty research lab in tissue engineering, biomaterials, drug delivery, or bioinformatics. Complete training in research protocols, lab safety, and scientific documentation.

milestones.label: Study bioengineering thermodynamics and transport
milestones.description: Heat and mass transfer in biological systems including drug delivery kinetics, oxygen transport in tissues, and bioreactor design. Students model real physiological transport problems.

milestones.label: Master bioengineering materials science
milestones.description: Study biomaterial properties, biocompatibility, degradation, and applications in implants, prosthetics, and tissue scaffolds. Students evaluate biomaterial candidates for medical device applications.

phases.name: Year 3
phases.subtitle: Develop
phases.description: Advanced Bioengineering & Research — Master tissue engineering, bioinstrumentation, and gain professional experience.

milestones.label: Master tissue engineering and regenerative medicine
milestones.description: Study scaffold design, cell culture techniques, stem cell engineering, and regenerative medicine approaches. Students design and test tissue-engineered constructs in the bioengineering lab.

milestones.label: Study bioinstrumentation and biosensors
milestones.description: Design and analysis of biomedical instruments including biosensors, signal processing, medical imaging systems, and point-of-care diagnostics. Students build and test biosensor prototypes.

milestones.label: Present research at undergraduate symposium
milestones.description: Present undergraduate research at a departmental or university symposium. Develop scientific poster and oral presentation skills. Network with graduate students and industry professionals at the event.

milestones.label: Complete summer bioengineering internship or REU
milestones.description: Secure an internship at a biotech company, medical device manufacturer, pharmaceutical firm, or NSF REU program. Apply bioengineering skills in an industry or advanced research setting.

milestones.label: Study bioethics and regulatory affairs
milestones.description: Analyze FDA regulatory pathways (510(k), PMA), clinical trial design, bioethics frameworks, and international medical device regulations. Students prepare a regulatory submission for a medical device concept.

phases.name: Year 4
phases.subtitle: Launch
phases.description: Capstone Design & Career Launch — Complete senior design project, apply to graduate programs, and launch bioengineering career.

milestones.label: Execute senior design capstone project
milestones.description: Complete a year-long senior design project addressing a real bioengineering challenge. Teams work with industry sponsors or clinical partners to design, prototype, test, and present a biomedical solution.

milestones.label: Prepare graduate school or industry applications
milestones.description: Develop applications for graduate programs (MS/PhD in bioengineering, biomedical engineering, or medical school) or industry positions. Prepare GRE, personal statements, research portfolios, and faculty recommendations.

milestones.label: Serve as peer mentor and lab teaching assistant
milestones.description: Mentor underclassmen in bioengineering coursework, serve as a teaching assistant for laboratory courses, and contribute to the department's research community.

milestones.label: Develop career placement portfolio
milestones.description: Assemble a career launch package including technical resume, research portfolio, design project documentation, and documented professional network for biotech, medical device, or graduate program applications.

milestones.label: Complete exit assessment and career activation
milestones.description: Complete the CoE Bioengineering Exit Assessment demonstrating competency across ABET outcomes. Finalize career activation documenting job offers, graduate admissions, or research fellowship placements.
